results.content:
The national political environment should favor the Democratic Party, as New York Times polling averages show Trump with an approval rating of 38% and the generic ballot polling shows the party leading Republicans by 5-7 percentage points. 

State Rep. William Lamberth, a Portland Republican and the majority leader for the House caucus, said the state GOP’s goal is to control all 99 seats, and they want to challenge “every race where a Republican is running against a Democrat.”
